name: Itsuka Tenshi ga Maioriru
original_name: いつか天使が舞い降りる
source:
It's Christmas night. Angels descend to Earth in search of love.

You are one of those angels. Will you be able to find out what "love" really is...?

[Translated from [url=https://bshadow.gozaru.jp/game/ituka/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
这是圣诞节之夜。天使降临人间寻找爱情。

你就是那些天使之一。你能找到“爱”的真正含义吗……？

[翻译自[url=https://bshadow.gozaru.jp/game/ituka/index.html]官网[/url]]
